content.title: Privacy Policy
content.body:
This Privacy Policy explains how Dial Infini (“we”, “us”) collects, uses and protects information when you use our website and app.

Information we collect

  • Account information: your name, email address and phone number.
  • Usage information: call and message metadata needed to provide and bill the service.
  • Technical information: device type, IP address and cookies used to keep the site secure and working.

How we use information

We use your information to provide and improve the service, process payments, prevent fraud, provide support and comply with legal obligations.

Sharing

We do not sell your personal information. We share data only with service providers who help us operate the service, or when required by law.

Your rights

You may request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal information by contacting us.

Contact

Questions about this policy? Reach out via our contact page.

content.title: Terms of Service
content.body:
By using Dial Infini you agree to these Terms. Please read them carefully.

The service

Dial Infini provides phone numbers, calling, messaging and voicemail over the internet. Availability and features may vary by country.

Accounts

You must provide accurate information and keep your login secure. You are responsible for activity under your account.

Payments and credit

Number plans and credit are billed as shown in the app. Rates are displayed before you use the service. Unused credit and plan fees may be non-refundable except where required by law.

Acceptable use

You may not use the service for spam, fraud, harassment or any unlawful activity. We may suspend accounts that breach these rules.

Liability

The service is provided “as is”. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses.

Changes

We may update these Terms from time to time. Continued use means you accept the updated Terms.
